source.probe: harfbuzz shaped width of a production vocalized Arabic body (1815 regular words, 8765 letters, Calibri vs the subset) = 0.833, bold runs 0.878; Word's own breaks run 2% tighter than harfbuzz Calibri (its 10-line paragraph, last line 0.71 of the column, is reproduced by the greedy model at 0.82; 0.833 still gave 11 lines in gen); box = Calibri hhea 1536/512 over 2048

note:
Calibri ships its own compact Arabic; Carlito has none, so Arabic in a
cs="Calibri" run would fall through to Geeza Pro (8.6% wider, taller box).
2026-10-14 scaled by a 57-letter pangram (278 vs 325 at 12 pt = 0.855). The
ratio is text dependent (the two fonts' letter forms are not proportional):
over a production vocalized naskh body of 1815 words harfbuzz gives 0.833, and
Word breaks its lines 2% tighter than harfbuzz Calibri (its 10-line paragraph,
last line 0.71 of the column, is matched by the greedy model at 0.82; gen still
rendered 11 lines at 0.833), so the face carries 0.82; bold runs (0.878) share the
face because Chromium only synthesizes bold from a face declared normal. Box
pinned to Calibri's hhea 1536/512 over 2048 so the fallback face never lifts a
Calibri line.
